notes.title: Lup full release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Lup has just transitioned from early access to full release.
With additional content and major bug fixes in this release, please continue to feed back and report your thoughts on the Steam community forums.

We love you all, Lup on!

Dan & Leo.
